subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt or port the open fork PR for this issue, or close that candidate and request a fresh same-repository replacement?
rationale: The source-level bug remains, but an open fork PR already contains the focused resolver/test change and blocks a second automated repair lane.

options.title: Adopt or port the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch as the implementation source, refresh it onto the current UI path, and require current proof/checks before merge.

options.title: Request a fresh same-repo PR
options.body: Close or leave aside the fork candidate and ask for a new upstream branch with the same narrow resolver/test boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt or port the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch as the implementation source, refresh it onto the current UI path, and require current proof/checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the current UI file move and channel UI/status history among the likely owners.
